defs.def: the day or evening before an event, especially a religious festival or holiday （尤指宗教节假日的）前夜，前夕

ex.s: When I was a little boy, ____ I looked forward to most was the dinner on the eve of the Spring Festival.
ex.t: 当我还是个小男孩时，____我最期待的是除夕夜的那顿晚餐。

ex.s: It can even help solve present-day problems: In 2015, scientists discovered that a 10th-century English medicine for eve problems could kill a drug-resistant virus.
ex.t: 人们必须知道一件物品是如何制作的才能保存它。

ex.s: Oliver Twist Charles Dickens THE ANALECTS KING LEAR MADAME CURIE A Biology Eve Curie 1 What do you know about these works?
ex.t: 《雾都孤儿》查尔斯·狄更斯 《论语》 《李尔王》 《居里夫人传》 生物学 伊芙·居里 1 你对这些作品了解多少？

ex.s: The Spring Festival in China, especially the dinner on the Lunar New Year’s Eve!
ex.t: 中国的春节，尤其是除夕夜的年夜饭！

ex.s: The most important custom of the Chinese Spring Festival is the big family dinner on the eve of the Lunar New Year.
ex.t: 中国春节最重要的习俗就是除夕夜的全家团圆饭。

ex.s: That is why millions of Chinese people travel long distances to get home before the eve of the Lunar New Year.
ex.t: 这就是为什么数百万中国人不远万里在除夕之前赶回家。

ex.s: On Christmas Eve, Grannytook a seatby the fire as we put up the Christmas tree.
ex.t: 圣诞前夜，奶奶坐在炉火旁，我们则竖起了圣诞树。
